purpose: Teach: フルタイム/所以/独禁法/両氏/所収/インタラクティブ/送受信/キャッチフレーズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員をフルタイムで雇うことを大切にされた
lines.en: When we were founding the company, Dad made it a point to hire staff as full-time employees.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Slight pause before recalling — the voice of someone sifting through decades of memory without hurry.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会社が愛される所以を語られた
lines.en: Yes. He always said that was the foundation of why people cared about the company.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm recognition. Not defensive — simply standing by what was. Pace steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、独禁法を順守する姿勢を貫かれた
lines.en: And he never compromised on antitrust law — he was strict about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful exhale. A thread of something bittersweet running underneath. Voice softens slightly, like holding something fragile and true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業者両氏の対談を企画された
lines.en: Yes. He even arranged discussions between the founders himself to make sure that stayed clear.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Each word deliberate. The tone of someone who watched his father take the harder path and understood why.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社史所収の記事を全て監修された
lines.en: He reviewed every article that went into the company history. Every single one.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 「全て」 — not boastful, just precise. Voice carries the weight of that thoroughness. A long, careful exhale.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはインタラクティブな商談を好まれた
lines.en: Yes. He preferred to build those business relationships face-to-face, not from a distance.
lines.style: Soft recognition. A small smile lives in this sentence. Not nostalgic — more like appreciating a principle that held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外との送受信も自ら確認された
lines.en: And he would personally check every piece of communication going overseas and coming back.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. The voice of someone understanding the care that took. Trailing slightly, letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが社のキャッチフレーズを考えられた
lines.en: Yes. The company's whole philosophy — he crafted that himself.
lines.style: Final statement, grounded and complete. Warm closure. The voice of a son who has carried these lessons into his own years of leadership.
